cases.name: LeaveReady
cases.role: Product strategy, UX/UI design and human-AI evaluation
cases.summary: AI-assisted commuting decisions; compares routes, makes uncertainty and sources visible, and keeps user consent and memory under user control. No live transport integrations or real bookings are claimed.

cases.name: HaeSiivooja
cases.status: Published web service and Android app
cases.role: Product design, UX/UI design and service design
cases.summary: Two-sided cleaning marketplace covering customer discovery, booking requests and status, and cleaners' availability and work management. No conversion improvements or user-test metrics are claimed.

cases.name: AURA Atelier
cases.role: Product strategy, UX research planning, UX/UI and conversational design
cases.summary: AI-assisted luxury styling: emotional context, curated recommendations and optional human boutique-advisor handoff. Personas and research plans are proposals, not completed field studies.

cases.name: CleanPeer
cases.role: Product strategy, UX research framing, information architecture and UX/UI design
cases.summary: Helps professional cleaners solve unfamiliar on-the-job problems using search, practical guidance and expert support. The primary persona is provisional; peer feedback is not a representative user study.

cases.summary: Website accessibility review workspace with evidence-oriented findings, explanations and suggested next steps. Example findings are illustrative; automated accessibility checks and AI guidance require human verification.

cases.summary: Website designed and built for a student-driven innovation environment, including content structure, responsive layouts, original icons, graphics and photography. No invented analytics outcomes.
